title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup Incident And M365 Tenant Compromise
content_md: Note: Create your free account in SOCFortress Signals ( https://signals.socfortress.co/ ) for: Global intelligence Security advisories, search & filters Microsoft Patch Tuesday & CISA KEV views Threat actor, malware & IOC views Source references, visualizations & timeline Account registration & MFA Intro Recent security disclosures detail an active cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to ConnectWise application identities , specifically impacting Cloud Backup environments previously known as SkyKick. Threat actors have exploited stolen application credentials to compromise downstream Microsoft 365 tenants , prompting ConnectWise to temporarily suspend affected services like Cloud Management and SaaS Security as part of its containment response. Security analysts have observed targeted waves of malicious sign-ins across multiple organizations, highlighting the critical need for administrators to audit Entra ID permissions , review authentication logs , and secure workload identities. In response, ConnectWise and managed security providers have released technical remediation guides urging partners to preserve forensic evidence, disable compromised connections, and implement robust hardening measures. Forensic investigations conducted by Huntress and ConnectWise revealed that the threat actor executed a multi-stage attack campaign. Across the broader ecosystem, approximately 1,000 Entra ID tenants experienced authentication attempts from the primary malicious IP
